text:
linda: Heads-up from vendor — APAC h100 (ap-northeast1) is seeing an emergency quota reduction due to a cooling issue. They plan to cap non-reserved projects at 60% of usual capacity starting 2025-01-12 07:00 UTC for ~5h. Link: https://vendor.portal/alerts/EMG-4412
omar: Yikes. Which allocations count as non-reserved? Does our Dedicated cluster for enterprise customers count as reserved?
vendor-bot: Maintenance note: Dedicated/reserved reservations are honored. Non-reserved = on-demand, spot, and standby fallback. Cap will apply per-project unless protected via support ticket.
linda: Ok — immediate ops: 1) identify non-critical projects running heavy sweeps in APAC; 2) add an "apac-evictable" tag to them; 3) request protection for up to 3 CI projects. Can someone run a quick inventory?
kevin: I can pull the job inventory and flag top offenders. Quick grep command I'll run in infra: `./scripts/list_jobs.py --region=ap-northeast1 --min-gpu-hours=2`
sree: I'll prep a runtime feature-flag to shift long-running sweeps to us-central during the window. Flag name: `apac_quota_emergency_20250112`. We can flip it via flags UI.
omar: Also, we should avoid touching prod reservation labels. I'm going to mark proj-customer-A and proj-customer-B as reserved in the ticket so vendor won't accidentally throttle them.
ci-bot: Notice: CI routing will attempt fallback cross-region if `prefer_cross_region=true` is enabled for the project. Current config: proj-ci-main=false, proj-ci-backup=true.
kevin: Inventory done — heavy APAC consumers: proj-tune-7 (12h/day), proj-sweep-3 (8h/day), proj-experiments (6h/day). I'll open PR to tag them as evictable: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4291 (draft).
linda: Can we canary on proj-tune-7 first? Apply tag there only and run one long job to verify scheduler deprioritizes it.
sree: Canary plan: set feature-flag + tag on proj-tune-7, run one sweep at 06:30 UTC to see where it schedules. If it routes to us-central or delays under 2m, we proceed.
omar: Opening support ticket now with vendor for 3 protections: proj-ci-main, proj-analytics-01, proj-alerts-svc. Ticket #EMG-4412. Vendor ETA ~90 minutes.
vendor-bot: Support note: replied — we can protect up to 3 projects for this emergency. Please confirm project names in the ticket to expedite.
kevin: PR opened with TF snippet. Excerpt:
```
resource "redwood_project_tag" "apac_evictable" {
  name = "apac-evictable"
}
resource "redwood_project_allocation" "tune7" {
  project = "proj-tune-7"
  tags = [redwood_project_tag.apac_evictable.name]
}
```
ci-bot: Canary scheduled: proj-tune-7 sweep job id=ci-55590 started 2025-01-12T06:30:00Z. Will report region and delay.
kevin: Canary ran — job delayed ~90s and landed in us-central fallback pool, completed successfully. Looks good.
linda: Great. Hold bulk tag apply until vendor confirms protections. If vendor denies protection for any CI project, we will flip the runtime flag and cold-route longer jobs out of APAC.
sree: I'll prepare the flag toggle and a short script to revert tags after the window: `scripts/clear_tags.sh apac-evictable --confirm`.
omar: Noted. I'll update release notes and post in #general about potential delayed night jobs for APAC teams.
vendor-bot: Support update: ticket EMG-4412 confirmed protections for proj-ci-main and proj-analytics-01. proj-alerts-svc remains unprotected due to quota limits.
linda: Ok — prioritize protecting proj-ci-main. For proj-alerts-svc we'll route to us-central for the window. Thanks all — I'll post a final checklist: confirm PR ready, wait ticket, then apply canary-only change, then bulk at 06:45 UTC if all green. :thumbsup:
